decisions.reason: Carrier wafers for smaller-diameter wafers are a low-cost extension of the core thin-wafer handling business and fit the stated direction toward reusable carriers, so with industry turnover growing there is enough slack to keep them even though they no longer appear on the website.

The Cu-interposer glass wafer is a flagship launched at SEMICON Europa and fits the direction toward multifunctional packaging wafers, so management would give it time to reach aspiration rather than start problemistic search.
The Wafer Universe off-the-shelf brand sits close to the established offer, needs few extra resources and widens a narrow product range, so its results likely meet aspiration and it stays.

Glass-based circuit boards are distant from the core and their results are uncertain, which raises the risk of withdrawal, but in a growing industry the firm's slack lets it carry the product for another year before judging it against aspiration.
